latest.title: Prehospital pulse pressure flags trauma bleeding
latest.finding: Prehospital pulse pressure predicted active haemorrhage (AUC 0.73, similar to SBP 0.74); each 10 mmHg narrowing raised the odds by 51% (OR 1.51, 95% CI 1.28–1.79), and PP ≤45 mmHg was best for rule-out given high negative predictive value

latest.title: ECPR in refractory OHCA: benefit past 60 minutes
latest.finding: Weighted 30-day survival with ECPR vs conventional CPR was 31.0% vs 16.0%, 21.6% vs 7.2% and 10.9% vs 3.2% at the 15-, 30- and 60-minute landmarks (adjusted risk differences +15.0, +14.4 and +7.7 percentage points, all P<.001), with benefit remaining significant through 120 minutes

latest.title: Instrumented manikin neck for immobilisation training
latest.finding: The prototype delivered six-degree-of-freedom neck motion with realistic low stiffness and head-angle accuracy within 0.89° RMSE versus optoelectronic motion capture
